transcriber_notes: Low-resolution niViz JPG (900x545, 2.09 px/cm): boundaries from bar edges and leader lines +-1 cm (122/121/118/107.5/95/65/58/20/10/0); the 118-107.5 and 107.5-95 layers have equal hardness, so the 107.5 boundary comes only from the dotted leader. Hardness from the numeric R column (1=F ... 3.67=P-, 2.33=4F+), consistent with the bars. Temperature is a line without point markers: kinks recorded (120, 110, 100, 80, 60, 40, 20, 10, 0 cm), axis -20..0 C at 8.75 px/C, +-0.2 C; top point at 120 cm (not at HS). Comment cells follow chart heights (lines at 107.5, 58, 20 cm); the PST 40/127 text starts at ~63 cm, inside the 65-58 layer. Moisture column (θ) blank for all layers.
